translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Fu Yanqing, military governor of Fu Prefecture, was made military governor of Heyang; Zhang Cong'en, acting regent of the capital at Ye and former governor of Kaifeng, was made regent of the capital at Ye and governor of Guangjin; and Ding Shenqi, commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army, was made military governor of Fu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，天策上將軍、湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加守尚書令、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On dinghai, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, and King of Chu, was granted Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and made concurrent Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Ma Xifan, Grand General of the Heavenly Strategy, military governor of Hunan, and King of Chu, was granted Acting Director of the Department of State Affairs and made concurrent Grand Councilor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，桂州節度使馬希杲依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，兼知朗州軍州事；

translations.literal: On jichou, Ma Xigao, military governor of Gui Prefecture, retained his former Honorary Grand Commander and concurrent Palace Attendant and was additionally given charge of military and civil affairs at Lang Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Ma Xigao, military governor of Gui Prefecture, retained his former Honorary Grand Commander and concurrent Palace Attendant and was additionally given charge of military and civil affairs at Lang Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 朗州武平軍節度使馬希萼加檢校太尉，進封爵邑。

translations.literal: Ma Xie, military governor of the Wuping Army at Lang Prefecture, was further granted Honorary Grand Commander and given increased noble rank and fief.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xie, military governor of the Wuping Army at Lang Prefecture, was further granted Honorary Grand Commander and given increased noble rank and fief.

sentences.zh: 以武平軍節度副使、岳州團練使馬希瞻為檢校太尉，領盧州昭信軍節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Xizhan, deputy military governor of the Wuping Army and training commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was made Honorary Grand Commander and appointed military governor of the Zhaoxin Army at Lu Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xizhan, deputy military governor of the Wuping Army and training commissioner of Yue Prefecture, was made Honorary Grand Commander and appointed military governor of the Zhaoxin Army at Lu Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 以武安軍節度副使、永州團練使馬希廣為檢校太尉，領洪州鎮南軍節度使；

translations.literal: Ma Xiguang, deputy military governor of the Wu'an Army and training commissioner of Yong Prefecture, was made Honorary Grand Commander and appointed military governor of the Zhennan Army at Hong Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xiguang, deputy military governor of the Wu'an Army and training commissioner of Yong Prefecture, was made Honorary Grand Commander and appointed military governor of the Zhennan Army at Hong Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 皆楚王馬希範之弟也。

translations.literal: All were younger brothers of Ma Xifan, King of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: All were younger brothers of Ma Xifan, King of Chu.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以宣徽北院使李承福為右武衛大將軍，充宣徽南院使；

translations.literal: On gengyin, Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Senior General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Li Chengfu, commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat, was made Senior General of the Right Martial Guard and appointed commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以前鄭州防禦使劉繼勛為左千牛衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: Liu Jixun, former defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made Senior General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jixun, former defense commissioner of Zheng Prefecture, was made Senior General of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏以印本《五經》書上進，賜帛五十段。

translations.literal: Tian Min, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, presented printed copies of the Five Classics and was granted fifty bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min, Chancellor of the Directorate of Education and concurrent Vice Minister of Revenue, presented printed copies of the Five Classics and was granted fifty bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有白烏棲作坊桐樹，作坊使周務掠捕而進之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，引進使、太府卿孟承誨使契丹。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Meng Chenghui, reception commissioner and Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury, was sent as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, Meng Chenghui, reception commissioner and Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury, was sent as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔京百司攝官親公事及五年，與授初官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that acting officials in the capital bureaus who had personally handled official business for five years should be granted initial regular appointments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that acting officials in the capital bureaus who had personally handled official business for five years should be granted initial regular appointments.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左諫議大夫司徒詡為給事中，左司郎中王仁裕為右諫議大夫，前鴻臚卿王均為少府監。

translations.literal: On guimao, Left Remonstrance Counselor Situ Xu was made Supervising Secretary; Left Bureau Director Wang Renyu was made Right Remonstrance Counselor; and Wang Jun, former Director of the Court of the Imperial Banquets, was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Left Remonstrance Counselor Situ Xu was made Supervising Secretary; Left Bureau Director Wang Renyu was made Right Remonstrance Counselor; and Wang Jun, former Director of the Court of the Imperial Banquets, was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, the day wushen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, wushen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以許州節度使趙在禮為徐州節度使，以徐州節度使李從溫為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xu Prefecture, was made military governor of Xuzhou; and Li Congwen, military governor of Xuzhou, was made military governor of Xu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Zhao Zaili, military governor of Xu Prefecture, was made military governor of Xuzhou; and Li Congwen, military governor of Xuzhou, was made military governor of Xu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己巳，中書門下奏：「請以六月二十七日降誕日為啟聖節。

translations.literal: On jisi, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the birthday on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month be established as the Festival of Opening Sagehood."
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the birthday on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month be established as the Festival of Opening Sagehood."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州旱蝗，分命使臣捕之。

translations.literal: That month, drought and locusts struck the various prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi, and envoys were separately dispatched to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: That month, drought and locusts struck the various prefectures of Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi, and envoys were dispatched separately to capture them.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，追封皇故長姊為吳國長公主。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on jimao, the late Emperor's elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the late Emperor's elder sister was posthumously enfeoffed as Princess of Wu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇侄女永福縣主薨，輟朝三日，追封平昌郡主。

translations.literal: On guiwei, the Emperor's niece, Lady of Yongfu County, died; court was suspended for three days, and she was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Pingchang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei, the Emperor's niece, Lady of Yongfu County, died; court was suspended for three days, and she was posthumously enfeoffed as Lady of Pingchang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇第二叔祖贈太師萬友追封秦王；

translations.literal: On dinghai, Wan You, the Emperor's second grand-uncle, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Qin;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, Wan You, the Emperor's second grand-uncle, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Qin;

sentences.zh: 皇第三叔祖贈太尉萬銓贈太師，追封趙王。

translations.literal: Wan Quan, the Emperor's third grand-uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Quan, the Emperor's third grand-uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 皇伯贈太傅敬儒贈太師，追封宋王；

translations.literal: Jingru, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Tutor, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Song;
translations.idiomatic: Jingru, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Tutor, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Song;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉福王德贈太師，追封如故；

translations.literal: Fude, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Fu, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before;
translations.idiomatic: Fude, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Fu, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太傅暉贈太師，追封韓王；

translations.literal: Hui, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Tutor, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Han;
translations.idiomatic: Hui, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Tutor, was posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as King of Han;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉通王殷、皇叔贈太尉廣王威、皇兄贈太傅郯王重裔並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: Yin, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Tong; Wei, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Guang; and Chongyi, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Tutor and King of Tan, were all posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.
translations.idiomatic: Yin, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Tong; Wei, the Emperor's paternal uncle, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Guang; and Chongyi, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Tutor and King of Tan, were all posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太師沂王重信追封楚王；

translations.literal: Chongxin, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and King of Yi, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chu;
translations.idiomatic: Chongxin, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and King of Yi, was posthumously enfeoffed as King of Chu;

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太傅虢王重乂、皇兄贈太師夔王重進、皇弟贈太尉陳王重杲等並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: Chongyi, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Tutor and King of Guo; Chongjin, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and King of Kui; Chonggao, the Emperor's younger brother, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Chen, and others were all posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chongyi, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Tutor and King of Guo; Chongjin, the Emperor's elder brother, posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and King of Kui; Chonggao, the Emperor's younger brother, posthumously granted Grand Commander and King of Chen, and others were all posthumously granted Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.

sentences.zh: 仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture ceremony.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以御史中丞王易簡為尚書左丞，以禮部侍郎張允為御史中丞，以中書舍人吳承範為禮部侍郎，以吏部侍郎王延為尚書右丞，以尚書右丞王松為吏部侍郎，以兵部侍郎張昭遠為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎呂琦為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎韋勛為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李詳為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafting Secretary Wu Chengfang was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Punishments Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafting Secretary Wu Chengfang was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Punishments Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命宰臣等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On guisi, the chief councilors and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the chief councilors and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，飛蝗自北翳天而南。

translations.literal: On jihai, flying locusts came from the north, darkening the sky as they moved south.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, flying locusts came from the north, darkening the sky as they moved south.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客李棁卒。

translations.literal: Li Rong, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Rong, Mentor of the Heir Apparent, died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「諸道州府見禁罪人，除十惡五逆、行劫殺人、偽行印信、合造毒藥、官典犯贓各減一等外，餘並放。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict stated: "For prisoners currently held in the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official corruption, for which sentences are each reduced by one grade, all the rest are to be released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an edict stated: "For prisoners currently held in the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official corruption, for which sentences are each reduced by one grade, all the rest are to be released.

sentences.zh: 」是時所在旱蝗，故有是詔。

translations.literal: At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere, and therefore this edict was issued.
translations.idiomatic: At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere, and therefore this edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸相國寺祈雨。

translations.literal: On yisi, the Emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, the Emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以螟蝗為害，詔侍衛馬步軍都指揮使李守貞往臯門祭告，仍遣諸司使梁進超等七人分往開封府界捕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on gengxu, because rice borers and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, commander of the palace guard cavalry and infantry, to go to Gaomen to offer sacrifice and report, and also dispatched seven commissioners including Liang Jinchao of the various offices to go separately into the Kaifeng Prefecture jurisdiction to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, because rice borers and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered Li Shouzhen, commander of the palace guard cavalry and infantry, to go to Gaomen to offer sacrifice and report, and also dispatched seven commissioners including Liang Jinchao of the various offices to go separately into the Kaifeng Prefecture jurisdiction to capture them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左羽林統軍安審暉為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On yimao, An Shenhui, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, was made military governor of Lu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, An Shenhui, commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army, was made military governor of Lu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 宿州奏，飛蝗抱草幹死。

translations.literal: Su Prefecture reported that flying locusts clung to grass stalks and died.
translations.idiomatic: Su Prefecture reported that flying locusts clung to grass stalks and died.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，貝州奏，逃戶凡三千七百。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Bei Prefecture reported that there were altogether three thousand seven hundred absconding households.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, Bei Prefecture reported that there were altogether three thousand seven hundred absconding households.

sentences.zh: 遣供奉官衛延韜詣嵩山投龍祈雨。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Wei Yantao was dispatched to Mount Song to cast a dragon petition praying for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant Wei Yantao was sent to Mount Song to cast a dragon petition praying for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以西京留守馬從斌為左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Ma Congbin, regent of the Western Capital, was made Senior General of the Left Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Ma Congbin, regent of the Western Capital, was made Senior General of the Left Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 開封府界飛蝗自死。

translations.literal: Within the Kaifeng Prefecture jurisdiction, flying locusts died on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Kaifeng Prefecture jurisdiction, flying locusts died on their own.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河南府奏，飛蝗大下，遍滿山野，草苗木葉食之皆盡，人多餓死。

translations.literal: On gengshen, the Henan Prefecture office reported that flying locusts descended in great numbers, filling the mountains and fields; grass, trees, and leaves were all eaten clean, and many people died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, the Henan Prefecture office reported that flying locusts descended in great numbers, filling the mountains and fields; grass, trees, and leaves were all eaten clean, and many people died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎吳承範卒。

translations.literal: Wu Chengfang, Vice Minister of Rites, died.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chengfang, Vice Minister of Rites, died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以將冊皇太后，遣尚書左丞王易簡奏告天地。

translations.literal: On bingyin, because the Empress Dowager was about to be invested, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yijian was dispatched to report to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, because the Empress Dowager was about to be invested, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yijian was sent to report to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 陜州奏，蝗飛入界，傷食五稼及竹木之葉，逃戶凡八千一百。

translations.literal: Shaan Prefecture reported that locusts flew into its territory, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; there were altogether eight thousand one hundred absconding households.
translations.idiomatic: Shaan Prefecture reported that locusts flew into its territory, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; there were altogether eight thousand one hundred absconding households.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以給事中符蒙為禮部侍郎，以左諫議大夫裴坦為給事中。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Supervising Secretary Fu Meng was made Vice Minister of Rites; and Left Remonstrance Counselor Pei Tan was made Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Supervising Secretary Fu Meng was made Vice Minister of Rites; and Left Remonstrance Counselor Pei Tan was made Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣內外臣僚二十八人分往諸道州府率借粟麥。

translations.literal: On xinwei, twenty-eight civil and military officials, both within and outside the capital, were dispatched separately to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to compel the lending of grain and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, twenty-eight civil and military officials, both within and outside the capital, were dispatched separately to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to compel the lending of grain and wheat.

sentences.zh: 時使臣希旨，立法甚峻。

translations.literal: At this time the envoys sought to please their superiors and established regulations of great severity.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the envoys sought to please their superiors and established regulations of great severity.

sentences.zh: 民間碓硙泥封之、隱其數者皆斃之，由是人不聊生，物情胥怨。

translations.literal: Those among the common people who sealed their mortars and millstones with mud and concealed their quantities were all put to death; thereby people could scarcely live, and popular sentiment turned to universal resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Those among the common people who sealed their mortars and millstones with mud and concealed their quantities were all put to death; thereby people could scarcely live, and popular sentiment turned to universal resentment.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸州郡大蝗，所至草木皆盡。

translations.literal: That month, great locust swarms struck the various prefectures and districts; wherever they went, grass and trees were completely consumed.
translations.idiomatic: That month, great locust swarms struck the various prefectures and districts; wherever they went, grass and trees were completely consumed.
